Title: Service Fabric .NET SDK goes open source

Body.Content:
The Azure Service Fabric .NET SDK is now open source on GitHub. This includes Reliable Services, Reliable Actors, Service Remoting, and ASP.NET Core integration.

Making the SDK open source is part of the effort to make Azure a more open and flexible platform for developers. Azure open-source projects on GitHub have grown to more than 1,800 repos with more than 9,000 contributors.

Head over to the new Service Fabric home repo. There, you’ll find links to all Service Fabric open-source projects, documentation, samples, information on our development process, and information on how to contribute.

For more information, read the blog post.
